pages.text: $(bold)Syringe$()$(br)Attack livestock to draw its genes into the syringe; then attack an animal in $(bold)good$() condition (Satiety, Thirst, Cleanliness and Mood all 7 or above) and it conceives a young of that species, giving birth to 3-5 young on the spot eight minutes later.
$(bold)Vial of Genetic Fluid$()$(br)The sealed gene sample inside the syringe, recording where it came from.
